per_contradiction_resolution.resolution: Delegation tracking converged on the two-fact receipt (delegated, outcome). The retired seven-event receipt chain was removed from skills/plan-and-handoff/references/adaptive-work-protocol.md, skills/finish-to-completion/references/completion-ledger.md, and skills/finish-to-completion/references/slice-gate-protocol.md; each now points at rules/25-task-lifecycle.md as canonical owner. Seven-event names appear only inside the corpus patterns (as encoded contradictions).

rules/50-context-budget.md no longer classifies shape by file count ('Task ≥2 files = medium' removed); it now defers to 25-task-lifecycle.md and classifies by risk/dependency/coordination/rollback/proof. rules/25-task-lifecycle.md remains the owner ('not a file-count classification').

skills/best-of-n/SKILL.md now defaults to at most two candidates, never exceeds two, and forbids recursion; it states that runtime clamps override skill-local defaults. skills/plan-and-handoff/references/portable-plan-contract.md examples now use max_agents <= 2 and max_depth 0 with an explicit runtime-clamp note. A catalog-wide scan (all_skills_not_contains) fails closed if any skill advertises > 2 workers.

skills/browser-qa/SKILL.md now documents 'load qa-skills only when QA reasoning is needed' (smallest sufficient proof); a deterministic browser verification needs only the Playwright Agent CLI. skills/browser-qa/references/runbook.md makes the qa-skills matrix conditional on QA reasoning. ROUTE.json routing shape was intentionally left unchanged because the committed route-parity corpus (17 cases, immutable for this slice) locks the current stacks.

skills/researcher/SKILL.md and skills/researcher/references/usage.md now hand research to the portable plan contract instead of the legacy PAF template. skills/plan-and-handoff/references/plan-artifact-template.md carries an explicit LEGACY banner pointing to portable-plan-contract.md.

skills/frontend-architect/SKILL.md now states mechanically that an approved Control Plane brief owns visual precedence and this skill's generic font/dark-mode/animation/markup-only guidance cannot override it. skills/ui-taste/SKILL.md states the Control Plane brief is authoritative and ui-taste is a brief/taste lens only when the brief selects it.
